projects.name: Nordic Botanical — Brand Architecture & E-Commerce Flagship
projects.description: SAMPLE DEMONSTRATION PROJECT: Transform Nordic Botanical’s digital flagship with a refined editorial design system, transparent ingredient storytelling, and a streamlined checkout architecture.
objectives: Unify brand storytelling and product discovery within an accessible, Swiss-inspired editorial layout.
Increase mobile product-page clarity and reduce checkout friction across international currencies.
Deliver a documented component library so the internal team can launch seasonal campaigns independently.

deliverables.title: UX Audit, Information Architecture & Wireframes
deliverables.description: Analytics review, customer journey mapping, and interactive wireframes for 8 core views.

deliverables.title: Editorial Design System & Responsive UI Screens
deliverables.description: Typography scale, color tokens, product card components, and interactive Figma prototypes.

deliverables.title: Frontend Implementation & Storefront Integration
deliverables.description: Clean semantic HTML/CSS/TypeScript engineering, animations, and headless storefront templates.

milestones.name: Milestone 01: Discovery & Architecture Sign-off
milestones.description: Delivery of UX audit and approved interactive wireframes.

milestones.name: Milestone 02: Design System & UI Prototype Approval
milestones.description: Complete design token library and high-fidelity UI sign-off.

milestones.name: Milestone 03: Production Launch & Team Handover
milestones.description: Final QA verification, deployment, and documentation delivery.
